findings.governingReading: Shirou’s self-rebuke cites a cumulative count of forty broken lamps, without exceeding it.
findings.explanation: Exactly forty lamps already broken across the exercises becomes more than forty.

findings.highlight: I think it's because I can feel Tohsaka's magical energy seeping from the shed. It pulses with enmity.
findings.evidenceJa: 敵意に満ちた遠坂の魔力の波だったと思う
findings.governingReading: He thinks the sensation may have been a wave of Rin’s magical energy filled with hostility; his perception governs source and quality.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s uncertain identification of a hostile wave of Rin’s energy becomes a certain energy reading with only its cause hedged.

findings.governingReading: Her mutter questions Shirou’s nature or identity after observing the impossible phenomenon.
findings.explanation: Rin’s “What is he?” becomes “What’s up with him?”

findings.evidenceJa: 怒りとも、畏れとも取れない
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot decide whether Rin’s murmur expresses anger or fearful awe.
findings.explanation: An emotion impossible to classify as anger or awe becomes both anger and nervousness.

findings.evidenceJa: 貴女この事に気が付いてたわね
findings.governingReading: Rin presses Saber with “You noticed this, didn’t you?” before Saber rejects that level of understanding.
findings.explanation: Rin’s leading accusation that Saber had noticed becomes a neutral question about knowing.

findings.highlight: what kind of Mystics you're talking about
findings.governingReading: Rin says every form of mystery ultimately brings something existing elsewhere here for use.
findings.explanation: Any mystery or mystical phenomenon becomes “what kind of Mystics.”

findings.highlight: take something from somewhere else and put it to use
findings.evidenceJa: 余所にあるものを此処に持ってきて使っている
findings.governingReading: Rin’s contrast depends on moving what exists elsewhere into this place versus shaping what exists nowhere.
findings.explanation: Ordinary magecraft bringing an elsewhere-existing thing “here” loses the destination.

findings.evidenceJa: 此処には在ってはならないモノ
findings.governingReading: Shirou gives form here to what exists nowhere and must not be present in this reality/location.
findings.explanation: Something that should not exist here becomes something that should not exist at all.

findings.evidenceJa: ある魔術が劣化しただけのモノ
findings.governingReading: Rin tentatively infers that Shirou’s magecraft is merely a degraded form of some other magecraft whose name remains withheld.
findings.explanation: A degraded form of an unspecified certain magecraft becomes a degraded version of “it.”

findings.highlight: go back to her room and pretend I was waiting for her to come back
findings.evidenceJa: 部屋に戻って遠坂の帰りを待っていたフリ
findings.governingReading: He plans to return to the room and pretend he waited there for Rin’s return.
findings.explanation: The room Shirou returns to is assigned to Rin.
